scope: Empty site-search history admission and displayed-title deduplication

reference.method: Normal UI visits to two temporary localhost pages, each titled with the YouTube history prefix. No Arc injection or database writes. Test history removed through the History UI.
observations: A saved page whose title matched the scope appeared although its URL was not a YouTube search.
A second page with the same title collapsed into one displayed recent and consumed another history candidate.
The reference history mapper 0x102b77f88 constructs results from title and URL without decoding engine submissions; conversion 0x102b799a0 cleans the saved title.

Non-HTTP history activation and the complete reference ranking pipeline remain unverified.
